topic: Israeli Knesset Opening and Opposition Inquiry Push

en.title: Opposition Defeats Netanyahu Bloc in First Vote of New Knesset
en.dek: Israel's opposition secured a majority to defeat Prime Minister Netanyahu's bloc in the new Knesset's first vote on 11 November 2026.
facts: Israeli opposition defeated Netanyahu's bloc in the new Knesset's first vote
Opposition lawmakers led by Gadi Eisenkot proposed a 7 October 2023 inquiry
Israel's President swore in the new Knesset on 11 November 2026
Netanyahu remains caretaker prime minister until a coalition is formed
Israeli strikes killed three people in Gaza on 11 November 2026
body: Israeli opposition lawmakers led by Gadi Eisenkot defeated Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc in the new Knesset's first vote on 11 November 2026, according to Anadolu Ajansı and The Jerusalem Post. The Jerusalem Post reported that the vote victory paves the way for the opposition to shape legislation.

Israel's President swore in the new Knesset earlier the same day, while the Netanyahu government remains in power until a coalition is formed, according to CBN.com and Africanews. During the first session, opposition lawmakers proposed a commission of inquiry into the events of 7 October 2023, according to The New York Times.

Le Monde and DW reported that the parliament holds the authority to establish such an inquiry commission with investigative powers before a new government is formed. Eisenkot pledged swift legislative reforms prior to government formation, while his bloc unveiled an anti-Netanyahu agenda that included the proposed probe.

Israeli strikes killed three people in Gaza on 11 November 2026, according to Anadolu Ajansı and WMBD. Anadolu Ajansı reported that the strikes were a new ceasefire violation, while WMBD cited medics stating that two brothers were among the dead.

Netanyahu denied that Israel is to blame for conditions in Gaza camps, according to reports from KTVN and The Killeen Daily Herald on 11 November 2026. Both outlets listed his denial alongside other Middle East news developments.

Media reporting on Gaza also expanded outside the region as the documentary film NAZA reached over 1.5 million worldwide cinema admissions by 6 November 2026. The Guardian and Variety reported that the documentary details surveillance and killings in Gaza.
en.context: The new Knesset was sworn in while Benjamin Netanyahu remained in a caretaker prime minister role pending coalition formation. Parliament retains authority to set up investigative commissions before a new government takes office.

Israel's President swore in the new Knesset on 11 November 2026, according to CBN.com and Africanews. The Netanyahu government remains until a coalition is formed.

The new parliament held its first session on the same day, and opposition lawmakers used the session to push for an October 7 inquiry, according to The New York Times. Opposition lawmakers led by Gadi Eisenkot proposed a commission of inquiry into the events of October 7, 2023, according to Le Monde and DW.

Le Monde and DW reported that the parliament has the authority to establish such a commission with investigative powers before a new government is formed. Eisenkot pledged swift legislative reforms before government formation in Israel, according to Le Monde.
DW reported that the Eisenkot bloc unveiled an anti-Netanyahu agenda as the new Knesset was sworn in. The agenda included the proposed October 7 probe.

it.body: Il documentario NAZA ha registrato oltre 1,5 milioni di spettatori in tutto il mondo al 6 novembre. Il film descrive in dettaglio la sorveglianza e le uccisioni a Gaza, secondo quanto riportato da The Guardian e Variety.
it.headline: Il documentario sul conflitto a Gaza raggiunge 1,5 milioni di spettatori

ja.body: ドキュメンタリー映画『NAZA』は、11月6日時点で世界中で150万人以上の視聴を記録した。ガーディアン紙やヴァラエティ誌の報道によると、この映画はガザにおける監視と殺害を詳述している。
ja.headline: ガザ紛争に関するドキュメンタリーが150万人の視聴者を記録

ko.body: 보도에 따르면 다큐멘터리 영화 NAZA는 11월 6일 기준 전 세계적으로 150만 회 이상 시청되었다. 이 영화는 가자지구 내 감시와 살해 사건들을 상세히 다루고 있으며, 가디언과 버라이어티의 보도에 따른 것이다.
ko.headline: 가자 분쟁 다큐멘터리 150만 명 시청 기록

pt.body: O filme documentário NAZA registou mais de 1,5 milhão de visualizações em todo o mundo até 6 de novembro. O filme detalha vigilância e execuções em Gaza, segundo relatórios do The Guardian e da Variety.
pt.headline: Documentário sobre o conflito em Gaza atinge 1,5 milhões de espetadores

zh.body: 据《卫报》和《综艺》报道，纪录片《NAZA》截至11月6日，全球累计观看人数超过150万。该片详细记录了加沙的监视和杀戮事件。
zh.headline: 关于加沙冲突的纪录片观看人数达150万

sources.title: NAZA documentary on Gaza killings becomes one of year’s most watched
‘NAZA’ From ‘No Other Land’ Co-Directors Passes 1.5 Million Cinema Admissions Worldwide

de.body: Millionen Arbeitnehmer in Spanien beteiligen sich am Mittwoch an einem Generalstreik. Laut NPR und der South China Morning Post soll der Streik staatliche Maßnahmen gegen die nationale Wohnungskrise erzwingen.
de.headline: Spanische Arbeitnehmer streiken wegen Wohnungsnot

en.body: Millions of workers in Spain are participating in a general strike on Wednesday. According to NPR and the South China Morning Post, the strike is intended to demand government action regarding the national housing crisis.
en.headline: Spanish workers hold general strike over housing

es.body: Millones de trabajadores en España participan este miércoles en una huelga general. Según NPR y el South China Morning Post, la huelga tiene como objetivo exigir medidas gubernamentales ante la crisis nacional de la vivienda.
es.headline: Trabajadores españoles convocan una huelga general por la vivienda

fr.body: Des millions de travailleurs en Espagne participent à une grève générale mercredi. Selon NPR et le South China Morning Post, cette grève vise à exiger une action gouvernementale concernant la crise nationale du logement.
fr.headline: Des travailleurs espagnols organisent une grève générale pour le logement

it.body: Milioni di lavoratori in Spagna partecipano mercoledì a uno sciopero generale. Secondo NPR e il South China Morning Post, l'agitazione mira a richiedere un intervento del governo riguardo alla crisi abitativa nazionale.
it.headline: Sciopero generale dei lavoratori in Spagna per l'emergenza abitativa

ja.body: 水曜日、スペインの数百万人の労働者がゼネラルストに参加する。NPRや南華早報によると、このストは国家的な住宅危機に対する政府の行動を要求することを目的としている。
ja.headline: スペインの労働者、住宅問題でゼネラルストを敢行

ko.body: 수백만 명의 스페인 노동자들이 수요일 총파업에 참여한다. NPR과 사우스차이나모닝포스트에 따르면, 이번 파업은 국가적 주택 위기에 대한 정부 조치를 요구하기 위한 것이다.
ko.headline: 스페인 노동자들, 주택 문제로 총파업

pt.body: Milhões de trabalhadores em Espanha participam numa greve geral na quarta-feira. De acordo com a NPR e o South China Morning Post, a greve visa exigir ação governamental relativamente à crise nacional de habitação.
pt.headline: Trabalhadores espanhóis realizam greve geral por habitação

zh.body: 据NPR和《南华早报》报道，数百万西班牙工人将于周三举行总罢工。此次罢工旨在要求政府就全国住房危机采取行动。
zh.headline: 西班牙工人就住房问题举行总罢工

sources.title: Spanish workers stage huge general strike, 1st in 14 years, angry over housing
Spain's first general strike in 14 years demands solutions to housing crisis

de.body: Die neu vereidigte Knesset hielt ihre erste Sitzung ab, in der Oppositionsabgeordnete unter der Führung von Gadi Eisenkot die Einsetzung einer Untersuchungskommission zu den Ereignissen vom 7. Oktober 2023 forderten. Laut Le Monde und DW hat das Parlament die Befugnis, eine solche Kommission mit Ermittlungsbefugnissen einzusetzen, bevor eine neue Regierung gebildet wird.
de.headline: Israelische Opposition fordert Untersuchungskommission zu den Ereignissen vom 7. Oktober im neuen Parlament

en.body: The newly sworn-in Knesset held its first session where opposition lawmakers, led by Gadi Eisenkot, proposed a commission of inquiry into the events of October 7, 2023. According to Le Monde and DW, the parliament has the authority to establish such a commission with investigative powers before a new government is formed.
en.headline: Israeli opposition pushes for October 7 inquiry in new Knesset

es.body: La recién juramentada Knéset celebró su primera sesión, en la que legisladores de la oposición, liderados por Gadi Eisenkot, propusieron una comisión de investigación sobre los sucesos del 7 de octubre de 2023. Según Le Monde y DW, el parlamento tiene la autoridad para establecer dicha comisión con poderes investigadores antes de que se forme un nuevo gobierno.
es.headline: La oposición israelí presiona para investigar el 7 de octubre en la nueva Knéset

fr.body: La Knesset nouvellement investie a tenu sa première session, au cours de laquelle des députés de l'opposition, menés par Gadi Eisenkot, ont proposé la création d'une commission d'enquête sur les événements du 7 octobre 2023. Selon Le Monde et DW, le Parlement a le pouvoir d'établir une telle commission dotée de prérogatives d'enquête avant la formation d'un nouveau gouvernement.
fr.headline: L'opposition israélienne réclame une commission d'enquête sur le 7 octobre à la Knesset

it.body: La Knesset appena insediata ha tenuto la sua prima sessione, durante la quale i parlamentari dell'opposizione, guidati da Gadi Eisenkot, hanno proposto una commissione d'inchiesta sugli eventi del 7 ottobre 2023. Secondo Le Monde e DW, il parlamento ha l'autorità di istituire tale commissione con poteri investigativi prima che venga formato un nuovo governo.
it.headline: L'opposizione israeliana preme per un'inchiesta sul 7 ottobre nella nuova Knesset

ja.body: 新しく就任したクネセトは初会期を開催し、ガディ・アイゼンコト率いる野党議員が2023年10月7日の出来事に関する調査委員会を提案した。ル・モンド紙やDWによると、新政府が樹立される前に、議会は調査権限を持つこのような委員会を設置する権限を有している。
ja.headline: イスラエル野党、新クネセトで10月7日の調査を推進

ko.body: 새로 취임한 크네세트는 첫 회기에서 가디 아이젠코트가 이끄는 야당 의원들이 2023년 10월 7일 사건에 대한 조사 위원회 구성을 제안했다. 르몽드와 DW에 따르면, 의회는 새 정부가 구성되기 전에 조사 권한을 가진 그러한 위원회를 설립할 권한을 가지고 있다.
ko.headline: 이스라엘 야당, 새 크네세트에서 10월 7일 조사 요구

pt.body: O recém-empossado Knesset realizou a sua primeira sessão, na qual legisladores da oposição, liderados por Gadi Eisenkot, propuseram uma comissão de inquérito sobre os acontecimentos de 7 de outubro de 2023. Segundo o Le Monde e a DW, o parlamento tem autoridade para estabelecer tal comissão com poderes de investigação antes da formação de um novo governo.
pt.headline: Oposição israelita pressiona por inquérito ao 7 de outubro no novo Knesset

zh.body: 新宣誓就职的议会举行了首次会议，反对党议员在加迪·艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）的带领下，提议成立一个调查委员会，调查2023年10月7日的事件。据《世界报》（Le Monde）和德国之声（DW）报道，在新政府组建之前，议会有权设立具有调查权的此类委员会。
zh.headline: 以色列反对派推动在新议会进行10月7日调查
